carla: spotted canary for r12.3 dropping tail latency in eu-west, feature flag rollout=20% for 'context-cache' started earlier. can we pause the rollout and pin routing to v12.2-stable? :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Canary r12.3 started at 2812342000. Alert: eu-west qps -18%, p95 latency +220ms, error-rate +0.9%.

kyle: on it. if we pause the flag, do we want to pin to v12.2 (known-good) or rollback the model variant? prefer pin to v12.2 for minimal churn.

elena: agree pin to v12.2. recommend muting downstream routing adjustments for 15m while we investigate. i'll run the ff command.

carla: running now:
`redwoodctl feature toggle context-cache --to 0 --env prod --reason "canary latency spike"`
I'll also pin routing:
`redwoodctl route set inference-1 --version v12.2 --pin 60m`
Updating release notes: https://internal/docs/releases/r12.3

deploy-bot: Action log: feature 'context-cache' -> 0 by elena at 2812345700. Route inference-1 pinned to v12.2 (60m).

sre-oncall: pulling traces and logs. If error-rate drops >=10% within 10m we leave pin and open slow ramp. Else we engage rollback full deploy (runbook steps 1-4). kicking off smoke tests and cohort traffic probes.

jeff: noted. i'll ping CS and the release channel with a short blurb. thanks everyone.

kyle: :thumbsup: will collect repro prompts and candidate regression tests for postmortem.
